data.summary: Musikakademie Beispielton confirms Bastian Musterquell's registration for the "Gitarrenkurs für Erwachsene" (twelve evenings starting 14 January 2027) and asks for the course fee of €216.00 to be paid to secure the place.
data.explanation: This is a confirmation of your guitar course registration together with a request to pay the €216.00 course fee. The letter contains two different payment dates ("bis 09.12.2026" to secure the place, and "fällig am 18.12.2026" in the payment box), so pay as early as possible to be safe and contact the academy if unsure which date applies. Transfer the amount using the IBAN and reference given. If you don't pay, your place may not be guaranteed for the course starting in January 2027.
